description: Low light, lower ceilings, and a hush of programmable-tint glass gone the colour of a bruise. A drink-printer glows behind the bar, chrome nozzles poised over a rail of real bottles nobody trusts it to replace. Muted feed-screens throw the studio's colours across leather booths cracked and re-taped, each one holding a writer, a wire-service printout and an argument about a lede. Every ashtray is full. It's swank trying a little too hard, and mostly getting away with it.
name: The Deadline
